**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Details | |---|------|---------| | 1 | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds and are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either:
• the **color** of the top discard card, or
• the **number**/symbol of the top discard card.
• A **wild** card can be played at any time. | | 5 | **Action Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip (+S)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+R)** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild (+W)** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+WD4)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | 6 | **Drawing a Card** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | 7 | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” If another player catches you not saying it before the next player takes their turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 8 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | 9 | **Game End** | The game continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Play Variations | Variation | How It Works | |-----------|--------------| | **Speed Uno** | Players must play as fast as possible; the first to finish a round wins that round. | | **Uno Attack** | Uses a special card dispenser that can randomly give 0–4 cards to the next player. | | **Uno Flip** | Adds a “Flip” card that flips the deck to a new side with different colors and higher‑value cards. | | **Uno Dare** | Adds a “Dare” card that forces the next player to perform a dare (often a fun challenge). | --- ### Tips & Strategy 1. **Keep a Variety of Colors** – Having multiple colors reduces the chance you’ll be stuck drawing cards. 2. **Save Action Cards** – Hold onto Draw Two, Skip, and Reverse cards for when you’re about to win or to block opponents. 3. **Watch Opponents’ Hands** – If you see someone with only one card, try to play a Skip or Draw Two on them. 4. **Use Wilds Wisely** – Save Wild Draw Four for when you’re sure you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge. 5. **UNO Challenge** – If you suspect a player illegally played a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge them. If they’re wrong, they must draw six cards; if they’re right, you draw eight. | Enjoy playing Uno!
